annotations.title: Find co-op games for a group

description: Finds PC co-op games on Steam that fit a group of friends and ranks them by how well they fit: group size, budget in US dollars, mood or type tags, typical session length, online or same-screen play, and platform. Each result has the current US Steam price, Steam's user-review label and the Steam store link. Use it when someone asks which co-op game they should play with friends or a group. It searches a curated catalog of co-op games on Steam (PC only, no console or mobile), refreshed daily from Steam's public store and review data; group sizes and tags are curated, session length is an editorial guide from the game type. The catalog includes a game made by Gamevato, the publisher of this tool; it is ranked by the same rules and labeled made_by_publisher when shown.

local_or_online.description: online = everyone on their own PC; local = same screen / couch; either (default).

max_price_usd.description: Highest price per copy in US dollars (US Steam store). 0 = only games with no charge.

platform.description: Operating system every player uses. Omit for any.

players.description: Group size including the user. Only games that support at least this many players are returned.

session_length.description: How long a typical play session should be: short (quick rounds), medium (about an hour), long (multi-hour campaigns or worlds).

tags.description: Mood or type wanted; a game must match at least one, more matches rank higher. funny (silly, chaotic fun with friends); physics (physics-driven movement and slapstick); climbing (climbing to the top together); driving (driving or vehicles); horror (scary, horror atmosphere); party (party game with short rounds); puzzle (puzzle solving and story campaign); survival (survival and crafting); sandbox (open sandbox to build and explore); shooter (shooting action); cozy (relaxed, cozy farming or building); rage (hard, rage-inducing challenge); competitive (players compete against each other); tethered (players are tied or chained together).

name: find_coop_games
title: Find co-op games for a group
